Global Z3 parameters and logging

Source: R/ast.R
z3_global_param_set.Rd

Global parameters apply to the whole R process: every context created afterwards, and some settings of existing contexts. Prefer per-solver parameters (z3_set_params()) or context configuration (z3_context()) when they exist. Values are given as R scalars and passed to Z3 as strings.

Usage

z3_global_param_set(name, value)

z3_global_param_get(name)

z3_global_param_reset()

z3_global_param_help(ctx)

z3_log_open(file)

z3_log_close()

z3_warnings(enabled)

Arguments

name

Parameter name.

value

A single logical, number or string.

ctx

A z3_context() used to read the descriptions.

file

Path of the log file.

enabled

TRUE or FALSE.

Value

z3_global_param_get() returns a string; the others return their input invisibly.

Details

  • z3_global_param_set(name, value) sets one parameter, for example "smt.random_seed" or "verbose".

  • z3_global_param_get(name) returns the current value as a string, or NA when the name is unknown.

  • z3_global_param_reset() restores all defaults.

  • z3_global_param_help() lists the global parameters (Z3 4.15.0 or later; in older releases Z3 frees its own parameter table when the list is released).

  • z3_log_open(file)/z3_log_close() record every Z3 API call into a file for bug reports. z3_warnings(enabled) turns Z3's warning messages on or off.

Examples

old <- z3_global_param_get("model.completion")
z3_global_param_set("model.completion", TRUE)
z3_global_param_get("model.completion")
#> [1] "true"
z3_global_param_set("model.completion", old)
